page: Vultr vx1-m-192c-1536g-11520s is a dedicated instance within the VX1 Cloud Compute family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD x86_64 processors. The system is equipped with 1430.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.45 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage, the instance includes 10720 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. This high-capacity local storage is bundled directly with the instance. The network configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. There are no graphics processing units included in this configuration.

The hardware profile offers high resource density, combining a large dedicated core count with substantial memory and local NVMe storage. This configuration is designed for workloads requiring significant memory capacity and fast local storage access, such as large-scale databases, memory-intensive analytics, and enterprise-level applications.
